## Darknet interface

Darknet API

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Darknet 
```

## Remarks

If you are not in BitNode-15, then you must have Source-File 15 in order to use this API.

## Methods

|  Method | Description |
|  --- | --- |
|  [authenticate(hostname, password)](./bitburner.darknet.authenticate.md) | Sends a network request to try to authenticate on a darkweb server. The target server must be directly connected to the server that the script is running on. |
|  [exec(script, hostname, password, threadOrOptions, args)](./bitburner.darknet.exec.md) | Runs a script on the given server. The target server has to be connected to the current server and have been authenticated. |
|  [getIp(host, password)](./bitburner.darknet.getip.md) | Get the IP address of a server. The target server has to be connected to the current server and have been authenticated. |
|  [getServer(host)](./bitburner.darknet.getserver.md) | Returns a server object for the given server. Defaults to the running script's server if host is not specified. |
|  [killall(host, password, safetyGuard)](./bitburner.darknet.killall.md) | Terminate all scripts on a server. The target server has to be connected to the current server and have been authenticated. |
|  [openCache(filename, suppressToast)](./bitburner.darknet.opencache.md) | Opens a .cache file on the current server to acquire its valuable contents. |
|  [packetCapture(host)](./bitburner.darknet.packetcapture.md) | Spends some time listening for unsecured network traffic on an adjacent server. If you are lucky, the server password may be somewhere in all the noise. |
|  [scan(hostname, showAll)](./bitburner.darknet.scan.md) | Get the list of darkweb servers connected to a server (or the current server if no hostname is provided). If <code>showAll</code> is true, instead returns ALL hostnames connected to the server, including non-darkweb servers. |
|  [scp(files, destination, password)](./bitburner.darknet.scp.md) | Copies the given script to the target server. The target server has to be connected to the current server and have been authenticated. |
